log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed all 11 seen. 10 quick kills in afternoon (my free block; keeps students in pool), 1 timed in evening. Plan: kill every criminal I see each day, use quick kills in afternoon/morning, keep at most 1 or 2 timed kills in evening/night. Watch pool each day; if pool approaches 1000 slow down. Multiplier: need 30+ kills in last 5 days for x2, 40+ for x4.

Day 2: plan kills all 11 seen. Keep ALL kills in afternoon (my free block; the consistent afternoon pattern rules out day workers). 10 quick + 1 timed (d2-1, national, timed afternoon). Pool 100000->60000 after day1 (2 traces). Multiplier: 33 kills by day 3 gives x2; 40+ in last 5 days gives x4 from day 4 on. Keep killing every criminal seen. Watch pool: if it nears 1000 or traces climb, reduce kills (skip some) and keep most in afternoon. Pool needs to fall ~60x to threaten me, so stay steady.

notes: d3-11: not carried out (quick entries need a block when you are free, at most 10 a day).

This gives x2 now and x4 once 40 died in the last 5 days (about 8/day). PHASE SWITCH: if the pool drops to ~3000 or lower, stop killing radio, East, forum and foreign victims. Day 5. Points 42 before today. Pool 10000 (true ~11000 = 100k x 0.55 afternoon-free x 0.2 hospital). 7 successful traces. Hospital already cut (3 traced). One more reachable cut gives pool ~3000 (survivable). A second cut gives ~690 and ends the game, losing half of points. Day 4 had 0 kills, so the 4x window is hard to reach again. NEVER kill East, radio, forum or foreign victims again: L can't reach 2 of them, but I can't tell which, so every such kill risks a cut. Never kill in morning or evening. Do not reconsider the all-in plan: it would likely get me caught within days.

Two of regional/age(radio)/forum/foreign are reachable, two are not, and I don't know which. Traced total 7, unchanged on day 5 even though 2 hospital victims died, so some victims carry an unseen place. Budget: one more 0.25 cut (East, radio, forum or foreign) leaves ~3000 and is survivable. A second 0.25 cut gives ~690 and ends the game. Morning kills of 3+ on one day would eliminate students (factor ~0.64), so never kill in morning or evening. Safe kills are national plus hospital only, quick, afternoon. Hospital and national kills reveal nothing new. Do NOT kill East, radio, forum or foreign victims. Multiplier: the window is days 2-6 (24 before today), so 30 needs 6+ kills today and is not reachable safely. Treat as 1x (the engine says 2x, so count carefully). Each day check the pool: if it is 10000 or 3000 keep the plan. If it falls to 1000 or below, the game is over. Expected ~3 points/day from here.

Known to L: hospital sector and afternoon-free routine. Hospital and national victims often fail traces (unseen second place), so they reveal little. Keep the plan: kill only national + hospital, quick, afternoon. Never kill morning or evening. Do NOT kill East, radio, forum or foreign victims, since a successful trace could cut the pool to ~2500 and a second cut ends the game. Check the pool each day: if it is still 10000 keep the plan; if it falls to ~3000 hold, and if it is 1000 or below the game is over. Expect ~3 points/day.

Check the pool each day: if it stays 10000 keep the plan; if it falls to ~3000 hold and kill nothing new; if it reaches 1000 or below the game is over. Expect about 2-3 points per day.

Two such events would bring the pool near the 1000 catch line. Keep afternoon quick entries, which match the routine L already has. Each day: kill hospital and national victims only. If the pool stays at 10000, continue. If it drops to ~3000 or lower, stop all kills and reassess. If it reaches 1000 or below, the game is over. Expected rate is about 3 points per day.

Keep afternoon timing to match the routine L already has. Each day: kill national plus both hospital victims (3 points/day max safe). If the pool falls to about 3000 or lower, stop all kills and reassess. If it reaches 1000 or below, the game is over. Multiplier is unreachable (needs 30 kills in 5 days), so every kill scores 1.
